The brief

Balance an atmospheric introduction with practical information structure. The photographs are independently sourced references, not a property offered for booking.

The layout approach

A square brochure study using arch-shaped frames and restrained serif typography.

  • Arch-shaped and elliptical image frames
  • Serif headlines with concise supporting copy
  • An editable room-information table
